source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 333 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-333.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 333 was established by Ordinance No. 21116, passed by the Dallas City Council on November 13, 1991. Ordinance No. 21116 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 21116; 25850)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-333.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 333 is established on property generally located at the southwest corner of Milton Street and Matilda Street. The size of PD 333 is approximately 2.983 acres. (Ord. Nos. 21116; 25850)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-333.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and other provisions contained in Chapter 51A apply in this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to code articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A. (Ord. Nos. 21116; 25850)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-333.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 333A). The approval of Ordinance No. 21116 and the development plan replaces any residential adjacency review or development impact review otherwise required by the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 21116; 25850)

sections.title: Phasing
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-333.105. PHASING.

Phasing of uses allowed by the site plan is permitted. (Ord. Nos. 21116; 25850)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-333.106. USES.

(a) The only uses allowed are mini-warehouses with an accessory office and caretaker’s quarters.

(b) Outside storage, as defined in Section 51A-4.213, is prohibited. (Ord. Nos. 21116; 25850)

sections.title: Wall Openings
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-333.107. WALL OPENINGS.

No doors or windows for Buildings A, B, C, F, G, and H, as shown on the development plan, are permitted on walls immediately adjacent and parallel to property lines, except those doors or windows associated with the office or caretaker’s quarters. (Ord. Nos. 21116; 25850)

sections.title: Maximum Floor Area
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-333.108. MAXIMUM FLOOR AREA.

Maximum permitted floor area for the office and caretaker’s quarters is 1,920 square feet. Maximum permitted floor area for the warehouses is 110,985 square feet. Maximum permitted floor area for all uses combined is 112,905 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 21116; 25850)

sections.title: Maximum Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-333.109. MAXIMUM HEIGHT.

No structure may exceed 32 feet in height. (Ord. Nos. 21116; 25850)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-333.110. OFF-STREET PARKING.

Parking for all uses must be provided in accordance with the requirements of the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 21116; 25850)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-333.111. LANDSCAPING.

Landscaping must be provided as shown on the landscape plan (Exhibit 333B). All landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X, including the provisions allowing the use of artificial lots. All plant material must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition at all times. (Ord. Nos. 21116; 25850)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-333.112. SIGNS.

All signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts contained in the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 21116: 25850)

sections.title: General Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-333.113. GENERAL PROVISIONS.

Development of the Property must comply with the requirements of all applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 21116; 25850)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-333.114. PAVING.

All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 21116; 25850)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-333.115. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 21116; 25850)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-333.116. ZONING MAP.

PD 333 is located on Zoning Map No. G-8. (Ord. Nos. 21116; 25850)
